title: High-signal generic assignments: one-property twin (context)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: an ordinary build identifier replaces the high-signal credential field name. Twin of "High-signal generic assignments: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of generic-token-high-signal-redact: context: an ordinary build identifier replaces the high-signal credential field name. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
